description: Sign EIP-712 typed structured data with the connected wallet (eth_signTypedData_v4 by default). Off-chain: no gas, nothing is broadcast. Returns the hex signature. Requires an active session — call connect first.

address.description: Signer address. Defaults to the connected wallet address if omitted.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 payload as a JSON string with `domain`, `types`, `primaryType`, and `message` fields.

version.description: Typed-data method version. "v4" (default) = eth_signTypedData_v4 — use this unless the dapp explicitly requires the legacy v1 method.

name: sign_typed_data
title: Sign typed data (EIP-712)
